top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A propane tank was observed in an outdoor area accessible to children.

top_violation_types.title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregivers pediatric cpr training expired 09/2023.

top_violation_types.title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §747.5105)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguisher was not mounted.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Release of Children (26 TAC §747.501(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have operational policies available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §747.4105)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The provider did not have the fencing up around the outdoor play area.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §747.901(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three staff did not have a completed Pre-Employment Affidavit in their personnel record.

top_violation_types.title: Fire- Extinguishing System (26 TAC §747.5101)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguisher was placed in a box sitting in a closet and not mounted on the wall.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Primary caregiver is lacking a statement of health from a local veterinarian.
